metadata.title: ai-local-model-ops - Sources
metadata.description: Local and self-hosted LLM runtime references: local execution, self-hosted chat UIs, Apple Silicon / MLX, desktop runtimes, portable packaging, lightweight adaptation, CPU/edge inference, and local optimization levers.

runtime_and_ui.name: Ollama
runtime_and_ui.description: Reference runtime for local model execution and simple self-hosted workflows.

runtime_and_ui.name: Open WebUI
runtime_and_ui.description: Self-hosted ChatGPT-like interface for local and private model usage.

runtime_and_ui.name: LM Studio
runtime_and_ui.description: Cross-platform desktop GUI runtime with in-app HuggingFace model browser. Supports GGUF and MLX model formats; targets non-technical users and rapid model comparisons.

runtime_and_ui.name: Microsoft Foundry Local
runtime_and_ui.description: Microsoft-managed local runtime with curated model catalog and SDK-first API. Windows / enterprise-adjacent developer workflows.

runtime_and_ui.name: simonw/llm
runtime_and_ui.description: Lightweight CLI for local and remote model experimentation and comparison.

apple_silicon.name: MLX (mlx-lm)
apple_silicon.description: Apple's ML framework for Apple Silicon. Primary path for on-device inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and custom generation pipelines targeting Metal. Supports quantization natively.

packaging_and_adaptation.name: LlamaFile
packaging_and_adaptation.description: Portable single-executable packaging for local model delivery.

packaging_and_adaptation.name: Unsloth
packaging_and_adaptation.description: Lightweight adaptation and fine-tuning workflows on constrained hardware.

packaging_and_adaptation.name: Machine Learning Systems (Reddi) - Ch.14 On-Device Learning
packaging_and_adaptation.description: Open textbook chapter on on-device learning. Table 14.1 quantifies how training amplifies inference constraints (memory footprint, compute, memory bandwidth, energy per sample), assuming standard backpropagation without gradient checkpointing. Amplification ranges are order-of-magnitude planning figures, unsourced in the textbook.

optimization_and_serving.name: vLLM documentation
optimization_and_serving.description: vLLM documentation. Source of truth for the current engine, speculative-decoding configuration, KV-cache quantization, and FP8 serving flags — check it instead of old tutorials.

optimization_and_serving.name: llama.cpp
optimization_and_serving.description: Reference GGUF inference engine underpinning Ollama and LM Studio. Source of truth for KV-cache quantization flags, speculative decoding options, and Apple Silicon Metal support.

small_models.name: HuggingFace Model Hub
small_models.description: Primary source for current Gemma, Phi, and Qwen model releases and version tags. Always verify point-release availability here before recommending a specific version to users.

small_models.name: Gemma Releases Page
small_models.description: Official Google Gemma release notes. Check here for current checkpoints, parameter counts, modalities, QAT or other vendor-quantized releases, and licence before recommending.

small_models.name: Ollama Releases
small_models.description: Official Ollama release notes. Check the current stable version, newly supported model architectures, `ollama launch` targets, and changed server defaults before quoting.

small_models.name: DeepSeek (Hugging Face org)
small_models.description: Primary source for DeepSeek releases, including frontier-scale MoE checkpoints and small R1-distill models. Check total parameters (for memory sizing) and the licence on the model card; frontier-scale MoE checkpoints are multi-GPU class, the distills are laptop/workstation class.

small_models.name: Mistral AI News
small_models.description: Primary source for Mistral releases, from small dense models to large MoE models. Check current sizes, licence, and context window before quoting.

cpu_and_edge.name: OpenVINO
cpu_and_edge.description: Intel inference toolkit for CPUs, iGPUs and NPUs; weight compression (INT8/INT4) and export via optimum-intel.

cpu_and_edge.name: ONNX Runtime
cpu_and_edge.description: Cross-platform inference runtime; dynamic INT8 quantization and execution providers for CPU and edge targets.

cpu_and_edge.name: MLC-LLM
cpu_and_edge.description: Compiler-based deployment of LLMs to phones (Metal, Vulkan) and browsers (WebGPU). Check current install steps in its docs.
